summary: Tested the multi-platform feature (LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, Threads, TikTok, YouTube) on the backend and frontend. Backend: the new test_platforms.py passes 21/21, with 8 real Groq calls: generate for instagram/youtube/facebook/threads/x/tiktok, regenerate for youtube and refine for x. The regression file test_hooklink_api.py also passes 22/22 after I updated it for the 30-hook library and the 503 error status. Each generated output follows its platform's rules: Instagram gets 6+ hashtags; YouTube puts the title on the first line and includes Chapters with 0:00; Facebook includes a question; Threads stays under 600 chars; X stays within 280 or a numbered thread with each tweet under 280; TikTok has HOOK/SCRIPT/CTA/CAPTION. An invalid platform returns 422 on all 3 AI endpoints. The library has 30 hooks, each with a platforms list, and the platform filter combines correctly with category and q. Frontend: the Workspace platform picker (default linkedin, hint text updates, icons in Recent Drafts) works. A real UI generate for instagram sent platform=instagram, redirected to /refinement.html?draft=<id> and rendered the Instagram preview. On Refinement, I checked the previews and badges for all 7 platforms using drafts inserted into Mongo. The char-count shows len/limit and the X thread format '3-post thread · longest N / 280'; it turns red over the limit after editing. The YouTube title follows the first line, both after apply-hook and while typing. Save, copy, preview-action toggles, Desktop/Mobile, refine-tone (real) and try-other-ideas (real) all work, and the sample shows LinkedIn when no draft is given. In the Library, the platform filters, icons, combined category + search, and load-more all work. One real bug: the refinement page overflows horizontally on mobile.

minor.issue: An unknown platform value returns 200 with an empty list instead of a 422 validation error. It is harmless, but it is not consistent with the Literal validation used on the AI endpoints.

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal page overflow: documentElement.scrollWidth is 478 on a 390 viewport. The action row (Refine Tone/Save/Copy/Publish) is a 'flex items-center gap-2' container without flex-wrap, so it is about 444px wide and widens the card. Publish is clipped off-screen, and #previewContainer/#postCanvas expand to 462px. This happens on every platform, including the sample. Workspace and Library do not overflow.

issues: The title (first line) appears both in youtube-title and again as the first line of the description box. Consider hiding the first line in the description, or keep it if this is intentional for editing.
apply-hook replaces the whole first line. For TikTok, that removes the 'HOOK (0-3s):' label, because regenerated hooks are plain openers. Consider keeping the label prefix when applying a hook.
The active platform pill is dark (bg-on-background) while the active category pill is blue. This is a minor visual inconsistency, possibly intentional.

action_items: refinement.html: add flex-wrap (and/or reduce padding on small screens) to the action buttons row and the toolbar, so there is no horizontal overflow at 390px and Publish stays visible
Optional: when applying a hook to a TikTok draft, keep the 'HOOK (0-3s):' prefix
Optional: validate the platform query param on /api/library
critical_code_review_comments: Backend platform support is clean: a Literal Platform type on all request models, PLATFORM_RULES injected into each prompt, and Draft.platform defaulting to linkedin for older drafts
Previews use innerText for body content and escapeHtml for profile data, so there is no XSS risk from LLM output

refinement.js updateMeta: thread detection only counts blocks that start with 'N/'. A single long X tweet over 280 shows red correctly; a thread with an unnumbered intro block ignores that block when computing the longest length (edge case).
The publish mock redirects to the workspace after 2s, as before (not retested this iteration)

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all flows work; one mobile layout overflow)

seed_data_creation: Temporarily inserted 7 TEST_ui drafts (one per platform) into the Mongo drafts collection; they were deleted after testing along with the TEST_ drafts and usage. The demo drafts were left untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run each pytest file separately, because each one resets db.usage on its own: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest /app/backend/tests/test_platforms.py (8 Groq calls, resets usage before each test) and test_hooklink_api.py (3 Groq calls). To test previews without the LLM, insert drafts with client_id TEST_ui and set localStorage hooklink_client_id='TEST_ui'. Library counts: total 30; per platform: linkedin 18, instagram 15, x 13, tiktok 11, youtube 11, facebook 10, threads 10.
